problem: Legacy regression and durable evidence replay rules did not account for current main advancing after an automation merge.
root_cause: github_main initially required observed_sha to equal the merge SHA, even though terminal recovery can run after later commits have advanced main.
prevention: Trust github_main only from the OIDC-verified terminal workflow.
Require production_readback_verified=true and a valid observed SHA.
Require null production run ID and null deploy ID.
Allow observed current-main SHA to be a later descendant because ancestry is proven by the signed GitHub workflow before evidence submission.
Keep descendant_live and canonical_run contracts unchanged.
